annotations.title: Get back into a book when the handle is gone.

description: Given the email address a book belongs to, Chorus emails that address a sign-in link and returns waiting, and nothing about the books. Given the address and waiting, once the person has tapped the link, it returns every book on that account with its handle. Nobody types anything into the chat. An address new to Chorus is let in at once, with no books yet. Holding the mailbox is the proof, so a book cannot be found by guessing an address.

email.description: The email address the book belongs to.

waiting.description: The waiting the first answer gave back, once the person has tapped the sign-in link. Without it, Chorus emails a link.
